notes: The key names TSQBench, but the packet covers the full TSQAgent paper. Data quality is the direct output task; forecasting and classification measure downstream selection effects. Reported split ratios do not establish chronology or leakage control. Decision utility is measured for the training-data subset action, not deployment profit or risk. The numerical tools return task-neutral measurements and remain GTS.

Controlled degradations, active-dimension labels and unperturbed-series preference targets encode the data-quality objective (R3.1). A benchmark does not itself implement a temporal function, so processing is dropped.
